name: Roblox
description: Ports agentic-workspace's four Roblox MCP servers (roblox-gui, npc-control, genie-kanban, genie-npc-control) into aw-workspace as TWO separate upstreams: aw-roblox (full pilot surface — Studio GUI automation + NPC/world control, 25 tools) and aw-roblox-genie (the in-game Genie NPC's narrow, chat-injection-safe subset, 16 tools — no scale_object/kick_players, Kanban access hard-filtered to its own cards). Kept as two upstreams on purpose: merging them would hand the Genie tools it must never reach.

skills.description: Pilot the aw-roblox live game and Studio GUI directly (Frederico's own use) — the full aw-roblox upstream (roblox_gui_* + npc/world control tools), config, and known gotchas.
The in-game Genie NPC's own narrow, chat-injection-safe tool surface (aw-roblox-genie upstream) — what it can and deliberately cannot do, and why.
How spawn_object turns a plain-language prompt into a build spec — the JSON schema, placement/routing rules, and module-reuse via reuse_of.
The rojo build + Open Cloud + force_shutdown_servers publish recipe for the aw-roblox game repo.

roblox_pilot_backend_url.description: Public subdomain of the roblox-pilot-backend custom app (container aw-custom-roblox-pilot-backend) that npc_control tools relay through. Same path the live Roblox server script itself uses.

roblox_pilot_backend_api_key.description: API key the roblox-pilot-backend container issued (its own data/api_keys.json). Routed to this app's secret store via POST /api/apps/roblox/settings — never plain config. Required for every npc_control tool; missing it, each tool call says so by name instead of a bare connection failure.

roblox_universe_id.description: aw-roblox game's Roblox universe id. Public, not a secret — used to cross-check Open Cloud's `updated` timestamp during roblox_gui_publish_workflow, and as the force_shutdown_servers messaging target.

roblox_api_key.description: Roblox Open Cloud API key (MessagingService: Publish Message permission on roblox_universe_id). Used only by roblox_gui_publish_workflow's force_shutdown_servers step. Routed to the secret store, same as roblox_pilot_backend_api_key.

roblox_place_name.description: Default Roblox Studio place window title every roblox_gui_* tool pins/targets unless a call overrides place_name explicitly.

studio_exec_base_url.description: OPEN QUESTION, unresolved as of this port (same discussion as aw-app-android-studio): base URL of an HTTP endpoint that can execute a command on a machine with Roblox Studio open, in the same NDJSON-streaming shape the monolith's agents-platform /api/clients/{id}/exec used. Left unset on purpose — no host to point this at was obvious when this app was ported. Every roblox_gui_* tool fails with a clear "not configured" message until this (and studio_exec_client_id) are set.

studio_exec_client_id.description: The client id path segment for studio_exec_base_url's exec endpoint (POST {studio_exec_base_url}/api/clients/{studio_exec_client_id}/exec). See studio_exec_base_url.

apps.reason: This app contributes an mcp.json entry (the 'aw-roblox' and 'aw-roblox-genie' servers) that MCP Gateway discovers and merges; without the gateway no agent can reach either upstream's tools.

create_genie_card/list_genie_cards call aw-app-notion's Kanban REST mirror (/api/apps/notion/kanban/cards) over the loopback workspace API. Not required to install this app, but both genie-kanban tools return a clear "aw-app-notion not installed" error without it.

dependencies.note: Runtime-enforced app dependency: aw-workspace loads mcp-gateway before this app so the gateway can scan roblox/mcp.json.
